name: Tempest Form
description: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack using a metal weapon takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage. A creature that ends its turn inside the elemental's space also takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
